learningGoals: Help your child observe and talk about the details they see in pictures. 👁️💬
Encourage your little one to build simple English sentences based on illustrations. 📝
Develop visual literacy by connecting spoken English words to drawn objects. 🔗🎨
Foster imagination by letting them create their own short stories from an image. 📖🌟
teachingTips: Sit with your child and point to different objects in the book, asking 'What is this?' in English. 👉📘
Praise their efforts when they try to speak English, even if they make mistakes! Appreciate their tries. 👏💖
Ask open-ended questions like 'What do you think the boy is doing?' to encourage thinking. 🤔💭
Use your fingers to trace along the pictures while naming the objects to build stronger memory. 👆🧠

funActivities.title: I Spy with My Little Eye 🕵️‍♂️
funActivities.description: Play the 'I Spy' game with the chapter's illustrations. Say 'I spy something green' and let your child point to the tree or grass!

funActivities.title: Story Time Together 📚
funActivities.description: Ask your child to give names to the characters in the picture and make up a funny 3-line story about them.

funActivities.title: Draw and Tell 🖍️
funActivities.description: Give your child a blank paper, ask them to draw their favorite thing from the chapter, and then name it in English.
